work-minutes.label: Focus length
work-minutes.description: Default minutes per focus session. You can also change this from the panel.

long-break-minutes.label: Long break
long-break-minutes.description: Default minutes for the long break at the end of a cycle.

rounds.label: Rounds before long break
rounds.description: Focus sessions in one cycle before the long break.

breaks-enabled.label: Breaks
breaks-enabled.description: Turn off to go straight from one focus session to the next.

auto-start-breaks.label: Auto-start breaks
auto-start-breaks.description: Start the break as soon as a focus session ends.

auto-start-work.label: Auto-start focus
auto-start-work.description: Start the next focus session as soon as a break ends.

daily-goal-minutes.label: Daily goal (minutes)
daily-goal-minutes.description: Focus minutes per day you aim for. Set 0 to hide the goal.

log-partial.label: Log interrupted sessions
log-partial.description: Count focus time from sessions you skip or stop, if they lasted one minute or more.

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Show a notification when a session or break ends.

focus-end-sound.label: Sound when focus ends
focus-end-sound.description: Played when a focus session finishes.

sound-volume.label: Sound volume
sound-volume.description: Volume of the end sounds, in percent.

custom-sound-file.label: Custom sound file
custom-sound-file.description: Path to an audio file, used when a sound is set to Custom file.

show-idle-count.label: Show today's count when idle
show-idle-count.description: Show how many sessions you finished today while the timer is idle.

show-progress.label: Show progress line
show-progress.description: Show a thin progress line under the countdown.
